Ran `vitest run` in sdk/react-native (vitest 5.0.3 resolved from the main checkout's node_modules because npm ci failed in this worktree with an npm config error): 23 files, 212 tests, all passed. method=test marks rows those tests exercise (delivery, session, sampling, crash, errors, integration). No wire capture beyond the existing ingest-stub test; no simulator run.

requirements.note: Meta-rule about how SDKs are judged; nothing to implement.
Telemetry goes as OTLP/HTTP JSON to /v1/traces and /v1/logs, but replay chunks go as gzip custom JSON (FrameChunk) to a non-OTLP path /v1/replay/chunks on a separate replayEndpoint.
Own event names are unprefixed and not OTel: navigation, ui.tap, app.lifecycle, feedback, log, http.request, http.request.failed; attribute `message` on log records is unprefixed.

Always registers its LoggerProvider, TracerProvider, propagator and context manager globally with no opt-out; the OTel API refuses to override an existing global, so the first clause mostly holds, the second fails.
Host code can reach the providers only through the OTel globals (and gets session attributes via the processors); there is no getTracerProvider()/getLoggerProvider() on the public API.
No MeterProvider or metrics exporter anywhere in src (grep Meter/metrics: none).
Events go through the Logs API with eventName, but withSpan() calls span.recordException(), which writes an `exception` span event.

API lives on the instance returned by initRUM, so there is nothing to call before init (getRUM() returns undefined); there is no public shutdown (only internal _uninstall), and calling methods after _uninstall is not guarded.
Storage is async AsyncStorage, network goes through fetch or the native async postOtlp; flush returns a promise.
addEvent accepts any name and attributes, including session.* and ouo.*; nothing rejects or counts reserved names.

Only the internal test hook _uninstall exists: it removes hooks, stops replay and drains within 2 s, but emits no session.end, closes no replay stream with an end record, and is not public API.
After _uninstall, initRUM can run again (setRUM(undefined)); same caveat that shutdown is internal.

architecture_notes: The RN SDK is JS-first: it runs the OpenTelemetry JS SDK (BasicTracerProvider, LoggerProvider, batch processors) inside Hermes and registers it globally. Session state, sampling (FNV-1a+fmix32 over a salted id), user identity and the delivery queue all live in JS: batches are serialised as OTLP/HTTP JSON and persisted in an AsyncStorage outbox, then posted through the native Expo module's postOtlp (gzip) or plain fetch when native is absent. Native code (the OuoReplay Expo module vendoring sdk/ios OuoReplay*/OuoCrash*/OuoVitals* and sdk/android replay*/signals*) only supplies replay capture, crash/hang/termination reports, app start and frame counters; it does not vendor the native OuoSDK session or exporter, so SIG-42's native-owned single session/queue/exporter is inverted, and replay has its own native disk queue and uploader. Replay is a masked screenshot/tile-diff pipeline sent as gzip custom JSON to /v1/replay/chunks on a separate receiver, so the whole section 11 contract (OTLP log record, replay/stream/segment ids, keyframes, sha256, ouo.replay.ended, format adapter, buffer mode) is missing. Signal names predate the spec: navigation, ui.tap, app.lifecycle, ouo.app.start (event), exception for native crashes/hangs/terminations, ouo.exception.kind instead of .source, plus event.name attributes and no ouo.view.id, schema_url or ouo.rum scope. Biggest structural gaps: no consent model, no beforeSend or URL sanitising, no bypass set for unsampled sessions, no ouo.sdk.dropped reporting or self-disable, uuid-style session ids, sessions extended by network activity and never continued across a relaunch, and throwing config validation.
